definition.title: Vintage Media Lab

registrationInfo.instructions: <p><strong>Space is limited!</strong> Check the <a href="https://library.cityofpaloalto.org/vintage-media-lab/">Vintage Media Lab</a> page to see if appointments are still available for the month. <br><br>If appointments are available, click the <strong>Book@Rinconada</strong> button near the top of the page. Otherwise, check back on the first Monday of the month for another chance to sign up.<br><br>Appointments are limited to <strong>a single two-hour</strong> appointment per week per person.</p>
